item.text: I’m checking Mistral’s current official documentation for supported reranker models and endpoint availability.

No—Mistral does not currently document a dedicated hosted reranker model or reranking API endpoint.

Mistral provides:

- An embeddings endpoint (`POST /v1/embeddings`) for models such as `mistral-embed`.
- A Search Toolkit with reranking components, including `LLMReRanker`, `CrossEncoderReRanker`, and `RRFRanker`. These are application-level toolkit components, not a standalone hosted reranker endpoint. The LLM reranker can use an LLM provider, while the cross-encoder requires your own model/runtime.

See Mistral’s [Embeddings API documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/api/endpoint/embeddings) and [Search Toolkit documentation](https://docs.mistral.ai/studio/search/search-toolkit).
